description: Run the platform engine to render all previews and produce a bundle (manifest + images), same as `phonebook generate`. When previews crash, keeps what rendered and says which previews did not, by file and line. Pass changed or files to render only the previews declared in those files, for a faster loop while iterating.

changed.description: Render only previews declared in files with uncommitted git changes. Ignored outside a git repository.

files.description: Render only previews declared in these files, relative to the project directory.

name: run_generate
